examples.knowledge_point: Calculating a Matrix Product Using the Distributive Law
examples.worked_solution:
We can apply the distributive law

$$
AB-CB=(A-C)B.
$$

So, we calculate $A-C$ first:

$$
\begin{aligned}A-C & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & -3 \\ -1 & -5 & 3 \\ -2 & 0 & 7\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}3 & 4 & -3 \\ -1 & -4 & 3 \\ -2 & 0 & 8\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =-{I}_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}AB-CB & =(A-C)B \\  & =-{I}_{3}B \\  & =-B \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-\sqrt{2} & -\sqrt{3} & 45 \\ -81 & \sqrt{5} & 2 \\ -2 & -1 & -\sqrt{3}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
